import re, collections, math

def extract_demo(txt,n):
    # text includes 'Demo pair n input' and output.
    sec=txt.split(f'Demo pair {n} input (30x24):\n',1)[1]
    ins,rest=sec.split(f'Demo pair {n} output (30x24):\n',1)
    outs, *_=rest.split('\nSame instance.',1) if '\nSame instance.' in rest else (rest,)
    def g(s): return [list(map(int,l.split())) for l in s.strip().splitlines() if l.strip()][:30]
    return g(ins),g(outs)
